notes.title: Cosmos Update 2.3.4 - Rift Pockets
notes.notes:
[h1]OPTIMISATION![/h1]
I have done a full rework of the Audio system which was a serious pain point for Optimisation and the game should actual run at least 200%+ better that It did before!
This work also took a very long time to get setup and optimised which has caused the delay on recent updates!

[h1]NEW TO COSMOS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the UI Interaction prompts for Shrines, Rift Core and Intergalactic Merchant Items
[*] Removed Rift Modifier Choices and replaced with  a more formatted Rift Event
[*] Updated the particles when you destroy a Large Asteriod and Small Asteriods
[*] Added SFX to the Firing and explosion of the Artifact spawned by "Auto-Turret"
[*] Updated the Visuals of the MLG Lighting Module to look visually more like a lightning bolt instead of a missile
[*] Asteroids have a 33% chance to spawn Health Orbs instead of items
[*] The Blink Ability now has a visual indication as a starship outline when its ready to be used
[*] Updated the HUD to collapse Artifacts in the inventory if the Artifacts are below a required amount of fill the first line of the Inventory bar
[*] Removed the hidden DEBUG Menu from the HUD to increase Optimisation as it was causing moderate fps issues.
[*] Added new sound effects for Hex Missiles / Blink Ability coming off of cooldown
[*] Updated the "Used" Shrine Particale Effects
[*] Intergalactic Merchant now has dialogue mentioning they spawned a Shrine when they arrived
[*] Updated the Particale effects of the Augment "Orbital Launcher"
[*] Updated the visuals of the Starship Bay in the Satellite
[*] Update the visuals/partiacles/Audio for the Active Artifact "Charge Launcher"
[/list]
[h1]RIFT POCKETS[/h1]
Throughout the rift you will see "Rift Pockets" change and adjust the Rift Environment, flying into these damages your starship and reduces your vision. Each rift will have a different map with varied rift pocket sizes and locations!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36355722/fb005d9aedbfdca1933aed40c49a102fdf23038d.png[/img]
[h1]RIFT ANOMALIES[/h1]
Added some new rift anomalies to dynamically change the map with the new Rift Pockets added this patch along with some balance changes on other Rift Anomalies

[b]Cosmic Rays (NEW)[/b]
The Cosmic Rift rumbles with the sound of more Rift Pockets

[b]Deep Pockets (NEW)[/b]
Killing an Enemy spawns miniature Rift Pocket

[b]Alien Invasion (ADJUSTMENT)[/b]
The alien starships can now be killed they just have a large amount of health

[b]Ancient Shrines (ADJUSTMENT)[/b]
Shrines also open a portal to another dimension

[b]Visions Of Horrors (REMOVED)[/b]
This removed the lull between fights and prevented the player from catching their breath at any moment. It was not fun or engaging so its been removed

[h1]BLACK MARKET[/h1]
The Black Market has undergone some much needed improvements with new visuals and a very cool new money making feature... play to find out!

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the "Space Shotgun" to have improved visual effects and explosion to be radial instead of multiple projectiles. This will improve the overall inconsistency with shotgun projectiles not hitting very nearby targets
[*] "Space Shotgun" explosion radius now scales with projectile size
[*] Updated all audio for Weapons to better match their utility
[*] H4 Missile Array weapon accuracy and speed has been increased by 100% to align it more to the other weapons utility along with a much more satisfying Audio overhall
[*] Renamed the "Moon Charm" weapon to "Lunarius Starcannon"
[*] Updated the "BX41 Plasma Cannon" visuals to better represent plasma projectiles[/list]
[h1]ARTIFACTS, CURSES AND BOONS[/h1]
[b]Boon of Curation (ADJUSTMENT)[/b]
Was: Collecting legendary items increases maximum health by 10
Now: Collecting Items increases maximum health by 1

[b]Micro Shells (ADJUSTMENT)[/b]
Was: 50% Reduced Projectile Size + 25% Increased attack Range
Now: 50% Reduced Projectile Size + 50% Increased attack Range

[b]Fast Loader (NEW)[/b]
+ 25% Attack speed
After killing a cosmic echo gain 10% Bonus Attack Speed
Loose all bonus attack speed upon taking damage

[b]Bomba (NEW)[/b]
Dealing damage sticks a sticky bomb to the enemy that explodes after a few seconds. Bomba has 5 second cooldown

[b]Firewave (NEW)[/b]
Weapon shots also fire a large firey infused plasma blast. Firewave has 3 second cooldown

[b]Catylist (NEW) (ACTIVE ARTIFACT)[/b]
Call down a Catyltic Crystal that attacks nearby enemies

[b]Orbital Laser (NEW) (ACTIVE ARTIFACT)[/b]
Fire an Orbital Laser that follows a path based on the Starship direction

[b]Fuel Cell Booster (NEW)[/b]
Killing an Enemy or Cosmic Echo grants a burst of Flight Speed

[b]Mine Injector (NEW)[/b]
Killing an Ememy spawns a homing mine

[b]Reverse Chambering (REMOVED)[/b]
+ 50 Attack Range
+ 10% Critical Hit Chance
50% attack speed

[b]Crate Of Coins (REMOVED)[/b]
+ 150 Gold

[b]Fuel Cell (REMOVED)[/b]
+ 25 Maximum Rift Energy

[b]Cosmic Bullets (REMOVED)[/b]
+ 15% Attack speed
+ 30 Ballistic Damage
+ 30 Maximum Health

[h1]AUGMENTS[/h1]
[b]Orbital Launcher (ADJUSTMENT)[/b]
Was: Using any ability launches a orbital missile at the reticle location
Now: Using any ability launches 2 orbital missiles at the reticle location

[h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an Issue with the Artifact "Strange Matter" in which 50% of the time Items spawned from it spawned from the Rift Core (0,0,0) instead of the Starship
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake with the ENTROPY Cosmic Echo description in the Compendium Menu
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake with the Rift Anomaly "Fuel Leak"
[*] Fixed an issue with Deans ARTHR drones spawning inside the rift, then flying outside if you spawn with "Intro Animation" on
[*] Fixed an issue with the Artifact "Wishing Star" that was failing to activate
[*] Fixed an issue with the Photon Wave Blaster Artifact projectiles always critically striking
[*] Fixed an issue with the Rift Anomaly "Orbital Corruption" as it references a a system that has long since been removed (Rift Energy)
[*] Fixed an issue with the Cursor and Crosshair that failed to update the thumbnail image when it was changed using the slider
[*] Fixed an issue with Curse "Cursed Firing Mechanism" that was causing shot inaccuracy
[*] Fixed an issue with Items spawned from Augments still showing their tooltip image
[*] Fixed an issue with "Ancient Shrines" UI not closing when the shrine is used
[*] Fixed wording issues with the "Random Stats" given from any source when shown in the Combat Log menu
[*] Fixed an issue with the merchant Health Upgrade failing to update the visuals of your "Gold" text
[*] Fixed an issue with the H4 Missile Array explosion end particale spawning before the weapon expired.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Challenge "Projectile Priorities" In which is referenced an Artifact that no longer existed. It now references the correct "Angled Barrels" artifact along with the new weapon "Lunaris Starcannon"
[/list]

[/list]
[h1]ASCENSION[/h1]
Ascension has always had a bit of a horrible feel to it, paying 5000 Star Shards to change the ascension to another co-pilot was just not worth it, Along with the Augments only being available for that specific Co-Pilot and only being able to equip 1 of the ascension augments. With this in mind, there has been some significant changes to the Ascension System;[list]
[*] You can Ascend with ANY and ALL Co-pilots at the same time, each time you do it adds a 2% chance per ascended co-pilot to find a [b]Ascension Entity[/b] within a cosmic rift (up to a maximum of 18% as there are 9 Co-Piliots)
[*] Ascension Entities are living gods transcended of their mortal bodies scouring the cosmos looking for life forms worthy of their gifts
[*] Challenging an Ascension Entity starts a challenging boss fight in which you must complete to earn a reward of the new and improved Ascension Augment
[*] If you already have all Ascension Augments, the Ascension Entity will grant you an Artifact
[/list]
[h1]CO-PILOT DEAN AND ARTH-R DRONES[/h1]
Dean and his Protector drone have been lacking power and its not been fun to have to always be near the drone to keep it active, forcing you to play around an AI that flys towards enemies. With this in mind Deans Augments and most important ARTH-R has undergone some exciting new upgrades!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36355722/c927d63b7261ad304e83ae08abd2ccbec785f66e.png[/img][list][*] ATHR-R now flys around the player, instead of towards enemies
[*] ARTH-Rs attacks are constant when an enemy is in range and home onto said enemy
[*] ARTH-R switches target to a new enemy overlaping their attack range if the previous enemy was killed
[*] ARTH-R flys to where the player has been not where the player is, meaning you can lure ARTH-R drones into an area for a drive by attack!
[*] ARTH-R is no longer alone! Each Dean specific augment equipped will spawn an additional ARTH-R drone (If your playing as co-pilot Dean, you gain an additional ARTH-R drone)
[/list]
[i]With all these changes the augments have been updated to relfect the new nature of the ATHR-R drone...[/i]

Updated Augment "S[b]hared Ammunition[/b]" now called "[b]Power Surge[/b]"
Was: Summons ARTH-R the protector drone (If you do not have one already)
ARTH-R deals double damage
Now: [b]Summons an ARTH-R the protector drone
ARTH-R drones deal double damage[/b]

Updated Augment "[b]Companionship[/b]"

ARTH-R gains overcharging bonuses when you use your Overcharge Ability

[/b]
[h2]ASCENSION AUGMENTS[/h2]

notes.title: Cosmos Update 2.2.9 - Elemental Power
notes.notes:
[h1]Update on the Cosmos[/h1]
Welcome Back Co-Pilot, We have received some intel from our deep space satellites regarding the eradication of multiple Cosmic Rifts in the Zeldari system, seem like the Cosmic Entities are holding off their attack efforts, or maybe losing? we are not sure yet. Here's some of the intel we received;
[list]
[*] Increased the Health and Damage spawned by Cosmic Echos in the Vivid Nightmare Rift
[*] Updated the Main Menu screen, Level selection screen and Collection Screen
[*] You can now buy Colour Sets from the Starship Hanger, These change the visual colour of your starships using animated materials and colour pallets
[/list]
[h2]Weaponisation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attack Damage has been replaced with Ballistic Damage
[*] Ability Damage has been replaced with Plasma Damage
[*] Summon Damage has been replaced Laser Damage 
[*] All subsequent items, Artifacts and Augments now scale with these new stats, 
[*] All weapons now have a specific Weapon Type assigned to them to allow game play diversity
[/list]
[h2]Rift Modififers[/h2]
In other news our Rift Scientists have been working hard to pull energy from the Rift Core using the Rift Modification device ([b]RMD[/b]) and with some success we have been able to pull all different types of energy from from the deeps of the Rift core;
[list]
[*] Stable Modifiers now grant Health Regeneration equal to the Rift Energy it requires to choose it
[*] Unstable Modifiers grant Gold, Items and Artifacts based on the type of Modifier chosen
[/list]
[h2]Enemies Of The Cosmos[/h2]
Our scanners have picked up some new and powerful entities lurking beyond the shadows
[list]
[*] New Enemy type "Overlord" will now start showing up after completing 25 or more Rift Events in one rift
[*] Larger and more powerful enemies will now show up sooner due to the increase use of the [b]RMD[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Augment Changes[/h2]
Augments have been a great contention for powering through rifts and progression in the game but some Augments have become over-preforming alot of other augments in the same tier, to this end we have adjusted multiple Augments to match their power levels per tier;

notes.title: Cosmos Update 2.2.6 - Enemies Of The Rift
notes.notes:
[h1]Cosmic Rift Modifiers[/h1]
Welcome Back Co-Pilot, We are happy to inform you that R&D have been working on a brand new [b]Rift Infusion Cannon[/b] that allows us to directly modify the Cosmic Rift and siphon the power. Management want you drain these Cosmic Rifts of all their Energy and return alive this time. 

[i]Here's what we know so far:[/i]
- Cosmic Rifts can be modified by flying to the event horizon and selecting a Modifer for the Rift Infusion Cannon to focus on, Then stand back and watch collect the energy (Any kill anything that tries to stop you)
- Rift Modifiers get more powerful the more you choose the same modifier, but at a cost of consuming more Rift Energy
- There are over 120 different Rift Modifiers to find so expect some Chaos!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36355722/f0a1f58b50c1bd0023835f10c459dded934e52ae.png[/img]
[h1]Changes to Base Gameplay[/h1]
- Ensouled Co-Pilots have been replaced with "Enemies" which come in 10 different types, the harder and more powerful enemies can be found as more Rift Energy is consumed
- All Cosmic Echos have custom Rotation movement that goes from their previous rotation to the new rotation preventing the weird and hanky snapping that was seen before
- Majority of Cosmic Echos have had their arsenal updated and summon enemies as part of their ability set
- The intergalactic Merchant has stocked some new wares in the shop and with the new addition of GOLD as drops from enemies and the ability to Summon the Intergalactic Merchant via the Rift Modifier screen you can be guaranteed to be able to buy Items or Repair your starship at least once
- Multiple Artifacts and all Boons and Curses have had their Images updated to better match the effect
- Updated the Compendium with all the new Information, Please check out the new changes if you are unsure on specific mechanics
- All Cosmic Echo stats are now tracked, and on completion of a Cosmic Rift (Or Death) you can see how well you did for each fight
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36355722/436e7b3c6b6eca2602b85e62606e13109f3d0d43.png[/img]

[h1]Other Changes/Upgrades[/h1]
- Updated the visuals of the Cosmic Rift, Rift Border, Rift Opening and Rift closing particle animations
- Updated the Main Menu environment to use better lighting and added animations for entering/exiting the starship hanger
- Enabled Anti-Aliasing to prevent the hard edges made by all Voxel meshes
- Updated the Crosshair and Cursor customisation to show what the changes look like to the Cursor/Crosshair that is not currently being used
- The Railgun now no longer has a critical hit zone you have to watch but charges 25% faster and deals 10% more damage
- Weapon shots are now 100% Accurate by default
- Multiple Starships have been re-designed like our "Starfinder" Starship awarded to those who are willing to pay the price for this Foxy looking ship!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36355722/4ccf0106b76ce82e3631ea55d69eba2964a8003c.png[/img]

[h1]Artifacts Removed[/h1]
[h2]Jar of Nano-bots[/h2]
Gain a Bonus based on your current highest offensive stat
Gain 5 Random Items if your Summon Damage is Highest
Regenerate 50 Health if your Attack Damage is Highest
Gain 100 Maximum Health if your Ability Damage is Highest
[h2]Pinpoint Module[/h2]
Weapon shots are 100% Accurate
[h2]Remote Backup[/h2]
Call for backup and Summon a allied Co-Pilot ship to aid you in battle
[h2]Interplanetary Support[/h2]
Call in Orbital Bombardment from outside the rift
[h2]Cluster Missile[/h2]
Launch a Explosive missile that explodes randomly over its duration
[h2]Death Targeting System[/h2]
Triggering Death Prevention grants increased critical hit chance and attack range for 10 Seconds
[h2]Backtrack[/h2]
Stores the current location of the Ship, Reactivating the item teleports you back to the location
[h2]Omni-Prism[/h2]
Using Blink has a 20% chance to restore a blink charge and a 10% change to restore all Blink Charges
[h2]Goro[/h2]
Summon Goro to help you kill Cosmic Echos, He grants Items and Heals you when you kill a cosmic echo

[h1]Artifacts Added[/h1]
[h2]Investment[/h2]
+150 Gold
[h2]Stellar Flux Cannon[/h2]
After scoring a critical hit, Stellar Flux Cannon emits shockwaves that damages nearby enemies
[h2]Reflective Shield[/h2]
Upon Taking Damage, deal 100 damage to 5 random enemies
[h2]Infused Crystal[/h2]
Killing an Enemy increases Max Health by 1
[h2]Delayed Reaction[/h2]
Weapon shots take time to arm but travel much further
[h2]Cluster Mines[/h2]
Deploy a cluster of Orbital Mines around the starship
[h2]Critical Collector[/h2]
Critical Strikes have a 1% chance of generating Gold
[h2]Shattershot Barrage[/h2]
Send out a barrage off missiles that shatter into mini hex missiles
[h2]Shock Nova[/h2]
Killing an Enemy shocks and damages all nearby Enemies
[h2]Healix Rockets[/h2]
Spawn homing rockets while your health is regenerating

[h1]Artifacts Updated[/h1]
[h2]Ray Of Light[/h2] [i]Now your able to shoot the Ray OF Light to deal AOE damage[/i]
Form a solid ball of plasma, Shooting the Plasma projects a wave of energy
[h2]Gray Fruit[/h2] [i]This changes allows for a random but fan way to cycle Active Artifacts[/i]
Gain a Random stat and Gain a new Active item with full charges

notes.title: Cosmos Update 2.2.3 - Celestial Divide

[h1]Celestial Divide[/h1]
Cosmic Echos haven been harnessing power from the event horizon of black holes causing their attacks to evolve.. But harnessing this power has its risks.. The new Cosmic Echos radiate energy allowing us to predict their attacks and prevent disaster.
[i]The Cosmic Echo now select their next attack after 1-2 seconds of delay after finishing their last attack rather than choosing an attack to trigger after 3 seconds. This prevents issues in which the Cosmic Echo could select a new attack while the other attack is finishing causing some unfair and unpredictable movement, Now the Cosmic Echo will only attack after their previous attack has finished [/i]
